title: chAInomaly
tagline: AI-powered blockchain transaction analyzer and visualizations using Google Gemini and D3.js
description:
chAInomaly is an advanced blockchain transaction analysis platform that leverages AI to help users understand and analyze transaction patterns on the OP Mainnet. This tool combines powerful visualization with intelligent analysis to make blockchain data more accessible and insightful.

## Features

- **Transaction Analysis**: View and analyze transactions on OP Mainnet
- **AI-Powered Insights**: Get intelligent analysis of transaction patterns using Google's Gemini AI
- **Interactive Visualization**: Explore transaction data through intuitive graphs and charts
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Clean, modern UI designed for both beginners and experts
how_its_made: The web frontend (ui) of this project was built with Vue.js 3, Tailwind CSS, and D3.js (for graph visualization). It uses Blockscout's REST API to fetch OP Mainnet transaction data and token transfers. Also, it integrates Google Gemini AI and @google/generative-ai for natural language analysis of blockchain transactions.
